subject: Recap + next steps: deployment mode & integration constraints (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-05T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Recap + next steps: deployment mode & integration constraints

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and the items we agreed to follow up on: 

1) High-level deployment direction
   - You indicated security and long-term log retention are top priorities; we discussed Hosted API, Dedicated, and Private (VPC/on-prem) as options.

2) Integration constraints you called out (please confirm):
   - SSO: Okta SAML + SCIM provisioning required
   - KMS/HSM: Keys managed by your KMS (AWS KMS / external HSM) and BYOK preferred
   - Logging: Audit logs retained for 7+ years, ability to export to your SIEM/archival store

3) Action items (who owns)
   - Alex / FintechCo: confirm exact KMS provider and whether HSM is on-prem or cloud-managed (timeline: EOD Wed)
   - Marcus (tech): propose recommended deployment architecture (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) and outline what integrates where (2 business days)
   - Marissa: pricing delta/ballpark for Dedicated vs Private and procurement timeline guidance (3 business days)

Attachments: I'm attaching the security requirements spreadsheet and a short SSO flow diagram so you can populate any missing fields.

Next step: Marcus will share a short architecture note tomorrow; can we aim for a 30-min follow-up on Thursday to review architecture + cost? Please propose a time.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: FintechCo_Security_Requirements.xlsx; SAML-flow-diagram.png

From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Daniel Kwan <daniel.k@fintechco.com>
Date: 2026-07-05T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps: deployment mode & integration constraints

Hi Marissa / Marcus —

Thanks for the summary — confirms what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side: 

- SSO: Okta SAML + SCIM required; we use SCIM provisioning today for groups and roles.
- KMS/HSM: We must use our AWS KMS keys; potential requirement for HSM-backed keys for some PCI-scoped data. Prefer BYOK where Redwood can integrate with our KMS or via a customer-managed HSM.
- Logging & retention: We need audit logs (API requests, responses metadata, admin events) retained for at least 7 years and exported daily to our S3 archival bucket and forwarded to Splunk for monitoring.

We also have a security questionnaire and a few compliance docs — attaching the initial questionnaire for your review.

We’re leaning toward Private (VPC/on-prem) given the KMS/HSM and retention needs, but we’re open to Dedicated if you can show the KMS integration and archive/log retention guarantees.

Procurement target: we’re aiming to have vendor selection and procurement kickoff by end of July. Legal/procurement folks to loop in next round.

Best,
Alex
Director of Infrastructure | FintechCo
alex.j@fintechco.com

Attachments: FintechCo_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-06T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps: deployment mode & integration constraints

Alex —

Appreciate the detail. Quick technical responses and what we can deliver: 

- SSO (Okta): Redwood supports SAML SSO today; SCIM provisioning is supported in Private and Dedicated (we can provision user groups into the private control plane). We’ll send the SCIM schema and a sample mapping.

- KMS/HSM: BYOK integration with customer-managed KMS is currently supported in our Private deployment (customer control plane or on-prem). For Dedicated, we offer envelope encryption with keys managed by Redwood; we do not currently support direct external HSM mounts in Dedicated. If HSM-backed keys are a hard requirement, Private is the recommended path.

- Logging & retention: We can configure audit export for Dedicated and Private. For Hosted, retention and export are limited by our multi-tenant policies. For your 7-year requirement and S3 archival to your bucket + Splunk forwarding, Private gives the clearest compliance path. We’ll document an export pipeline (daily export to your S3 + Kinesis/forwarder to Splunk).

Next steps from engineering: I’ll put together a short architecture note (Private vs Dedicated trade-offs, integration touchpoints, expected timeline for each option) by end of day tomorrow. I’ll include a checklist for the SCIM/KMS/log export fields so you can hand it to your security/infra teams.

Referential docs: I’ve attached our SOC2 summary and a short section on BYOK patterns. I’ll also add an estimate for the engineering work required for HSM integration if you need an on-prem HSM mount.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Attachments: SOC2-summary.pdf

From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@fintechco.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Kwan <daniel.k@fintechco.com>
Date: 2026-07-07T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps: deployment mode & integration constraints

Marcus / Marissa —

Thanks — that direction is helpful and matches our initial expectations. A couple of follow-ups: 

- Can you provide a short architecture note + one-page trade-off summary (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) and a ballpark cost delta for Dedicated vs Private? Procurement would like a high-level TCO difference.
- Rough timelines: if we choose Private, what’s the earliest delivery time (including KMS BYOK and log export integration)?
- Please include any pre-reqs our infra team needs to prepare (network, IP allowlists, SCIM attributes, S3 bucket policies).

We’ll loop legal/procurement on the next thread — please Cc them on the architecture + pricing note.

I can do a 30-min follow-up Thursday at 11am PT — either confirm or propose an alternative.

Best,
Alex
